Holly O'Mahony , The Stage: Mischief’s work is inspired by Michael Frayn’s masterpiece Noises Off and the rising farcical stakes of the first act bear a resemblance.
This finely tuned machine of comic timing and theatrical chaos is possibly Mischief’s best work yet, offering audiences exactly what they have come to expect – and love – from this troupe.
If you like Mischief's previous work, you will love this.

cn.t: The Play That Goes Wrong team delivers another crowd-pleasing farce with clever wordplay and physical comedy set during the Cold War. Critics praise the fun spy caper romp at the Noël Coward Theatre.
